Mixed purées

Liver and potato with vegetables

Zöldséges máj burgonyával

6 months+ Adjusted 35 min 4 portions

One portion is the week's liver, about 15 g of cooked liver in that bowl. Freeze the rest for later weeks, and do not also give a vitamin A supplement.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g chicken liver (raw weight, so each portion has about 15 g of cooked liver)
  • 240 g potato (peeled weight)
  • 80 g ripe tomato (peeled)
  • 60 g pumpkin (peeled and seeded)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel the potato and pumpkin, and peel the tomato.
  2. Cook them in unsalted water until soft.
  3. Add the liver and cook until it is brown all through, with no pink.
  4. Blend until smooth.
  5. Divide so each child's portion contains only about 15 g of the cooked liver.
  6. Do not add salt, and do not serve a second portion in the same week.

Adjusted

Liver is very high in vitamin A, so a large portion or a repeat in the same week is too much. A vitamin A supplement on top of the liver stacks the dose.

Fully cook the chicken liver, put only about 15 g of cooked liver in the child's portion, and serve liver at most once a week. Do not pair this meal with a vitamin A supplement.
